verdict.rationale: Box documents an event feed that lets an application subscribe to user and enterprise actions, monitor them in real time, or query historical records. That is a first-party change feed, which is the core of delta-style sync. However, the evidence never describes cursor or stream-position semantics that return only changes since the last call. Missing for 10: explicit cursor/stream-position mechanics for incremental polling, documentation of resuming from a saved position without a re-crawl, independent or hands-on corroboration of efficient delta sync.
